description: This Java class 'GroovyUtil' provides utility methods for evaluating Groovy scripts, managing script classes, and executing scripts within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles script caching, class parsing, and script execution with context binding.

classes.name: GroovyUtil
classes.description: Final utility class for Groovy script evaluation, class parsing, and execution within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates a Groovy expression with a given context, returning the result.

methods.name: getBinding
methods.description: Creates a Groovy Binding object initialized with variables from the provided context and expression.

methods.name: getScriptClassFromLocation
methods.description: Retrieves or loads a Groovy script class from a specified location, utilizing caching.

methods.name: parseClass
methods.description: Parses a Groovy class from an InputStream.

methods.name: parseClass
methods.description: Parses a Groovy class from a String of source code.

methods.name: runScriptAtLocation
methods.description: Executes a Groovy script at a specified location, optionally invoking a method within it, with a given context.
